facts: No snow or storms in the forecast this week; highs near 70°F at pass elevation.
No new snow measured at the 3 nearby stations in the 72 hours to Sep 28.

facts.text: The nearby stations disagree about this year: snow left Little Meadows (4,020 ft) 40 days earlier and Daly Lake (3,690 ft) 11 days earlier than the median of the three earlier seasons on file (2023 to 2025).

evidence.name: Little Meadows
evidence.detail: left April 20; earlier seasons: June 5 (2023), May 30 (2024), May 18 (2025)

evidence.name: Daly Lake
evidence.detail: left April 3; earlier seasons: May 15 (2023), April 14 (2024), April 12 (2025)

facts.text: This year's highest snow water on or after April 1 was the lowest of the four seasons on file (2023 to 2026) at Little Meadows (4,020 ft) and Daly Lake (3,690 ft).

evidence.name: Little Meadows
evidence.detail: 3.2 in on April 2; earlier seasons: 51.9 in (2023), 28.8 in (2024), 32.0 in (2025)

evidence.name: Daly Lake
evidence.detail: 1.8 in on April 16; earlier seasons: 20.0 in (2023), 3.6 in (2024), 5.3 in (2025)

facts.text: An estimate: snow left the pass itself between March 3 and April 26, carried from the melt-out dates at Little Meadows (4,020 ft) and Daly Lake (3,690 ft) to the pass elevation.

evidence.name: Little Meadows
evidence.detail: melted out April 20, 857 ft above the pass; points to March 8 to May 3

evidence.name: Daly Lake
evidence.detail: melted out April 3, 527 ft above the pass; points to February 27 to April 19
